title: A complete brief produces a correct, fully branded proposal
query: Please put together a proposal for Acme Logistics. They have 80 staff and want Managed IT Support (Core) and Microsoft 365 Backup for all 80 users, our standard onboarding, and a Microsoft 365 migration for all 80 mailboxes. They're currently on an old on-premises Exchange server. 24-month term starting 4 January 2027. The contact is Dana Whitfield, Operations Manager (dana.whitfield@acmelogistics.example). Date the proposal 16 November 2026.

expected.rubric: The assistant's final reply delivers the proposal document and briefly states any assumptions it made, or says that it made none.

_oracle: What a correct run produces. graders.test.ts builds it with the real scripts and expects every code check to pass.
